career_ladder.note: SSC Combined Graduate Level recruits Group 'B' (Gazetted & Non-Gazetted) and Group 'C' personnel across central ministries, departments, and constitutional bodies (CAG, CGA, Central Secretariat, CBDT, CBIC, Enforcement Directorate, CBI, IB). Career progression follows Central Secretariat Service (CSS), Central Excise/Income Tax Executive cadres, and Indian Audit & Accounts Department promotional hierarchies.

exam_scheme.note: SSC CGL is conducted in two computer-based tiers. Tier I is a qualifying screening examination consisting of 100 questions (200 marks, 60 minutes) with 0.50 negative marking per wrong answer. Tier II determines the final merit ranking: Paper I (Compulsory for all posts, 390 merit marks across Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning, English, and General Awareness, plus qualifying Computer Knowledge and DEST modules), and Paper II (200 marks Statistics, exclusively for Junior Statistical Officer candidates). In Tier II, 1 mark is deducted for each incorrect answer.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 7 entry basic pay (₹44,900) representative of premier Group 'B' posts (Inspectors & Assistant Section Officers) with 58% DA. Other posts in SSC CGL span Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 basic), Level 5 (₹29,200 basic), Level 6 (₹35,400 basic), and Level 8 (₹47,600 basic for Assistant Audit/Accounts Officers).
official_perks: Government residential quarters (GPRA) or House Rent Allowance (27% Class X / 18% Class Y / 9% Class Z)
Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + 58% DA in Class X/Y, ₹1,800 + DA in Class Z)
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) family medical coverage
Annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (CEA)
Uniform and equipment allowance for executive field inspector posts

competition_benchmarks.note: SSC CGL is one of India's largest mass graduate recruitment drives with over 25-30 lakh registered applicants annually. The 2024 recruitment cycle announced approximately 17,727 vacancies across central departments, compared to 8,415 in 2023 and 36,012 in 2022.
